name: Soybeans (CBOT continuous futures proxy)
sessions: Sun-Fri evening session plus day session, ~18 h
notes: Continuous futures series from the free provider: contract-roll gaps are not adjusted. Broker terms unverified. Daily price limits can prevent exits. gap_stress_pct = 1.25 x the worst overnight gap 37.1% in the cleaned usable history (floor per asset class, capped at 25 % because unadjusted contract rolls inflate the historical maximum); min_stop_pct = 25 % of the median daily range 1.54%.
